Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; FORGOTTEN HEROES RANGES AND RETREAT. +]

[+$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the environment and natural resources trust fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to Forgotten Heroes Ranges and Retreat, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to predesign, design, construct, furnish, and equip a new shooting range and retreat to accommodate handicapped individuals and disabled veterans. bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; appropriating money for a grant to Forgotten Heroes Ranges and Retreat.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; FORGOTTEN HEROES RANGES AND RETREAT.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the environment and natural resources trust fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to Forgotten Heroes Ranges and Retreat, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to predesign, design, construct, furnish, and equip a new shooting range and retreat to accommodate handicapped individuals and disabled veterans. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned. This is a onetime appropriation.
